Name: Katrielle the Glitch NPC - Custom NPC
Author: TipsSlight
Description:
[b][size=4]IMPORTANT NOTICE[/size][/b]

[i]Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for your patience! It is recommended that you use a new save file. There may be some issues, particularly with the dating path and the secret route, if you use an existing save, especially if you have already seen part of those events. Regardless, we hope you enjoy having the glitchy gal in 1.6 ^__^

Also, we have an art page now! Check it out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/3166]here[/url]!

[/i]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/X1CggtA.png[/img][/center]
[center][size=1]if you're wondering, no it's STILL not gonna be featured in the mod, soz [/size][/center]

[center]-----------------[/center]

[b]Best experienced in single player, with little to no visual portrait mods and little to no Beach map changes.

Mild epilepsy warning, particularly with heart events.[/b]

Katrielle is a glitched NPC, living in the void. Every day is the same. Plucking some food items from out the void, aimlessly using a computer while examining Pelican Town's every move, strolling through town unbothered since she is literally invisible, maybe playing a guitar here or there, then going to bed, only for the next day to repeat, and the next day, and the next. She wistfully watches everyone live their lives with friends and families and aspirations, but her life is comfortable and free of struggle, so she can't complain.

However, on one fateful day, a farmer moves into town. There's something special with them, as they are literally different from everyone else in Pelican Town. Unbeknownst to her and the farmer, a massive change happens to Katrielle, but what exactly? Suddenly, people are noticing her. It might be her imagination, but it's too risky to continue walking around town as if nothing's changed. It will be up to the farmer to help her along her way, and teach her how to integrate into society. Maybe she'll find a family, loved ones, and a home in Stardew Valley™.

[center]-----------------[/center]
[b]
Here are a list of completed updates/changes for Katrielle V1.3.1.
[/b][list][*]The only change is changing the music files from .wav to .ogg. This resolved an ongoing bug where the load times were a little slower than expected, especially when adjusting any settings for Katrielle in the Generic Mod Menu.
[/list][b]
Here are a list of completed updates/changes for Katrielle V1.3.0.
[/b][list][*]Seasonal outfits are included! In addition to the seasonal outfits themselves, the mod will also try to have Katrielle match the vanilla NPCs: if they have seasonal outfits, so will she. This can also be toggled under the Generic Mod Menu to enforce a single outfit type or seasonal outfits regardless. The mods that would automatically enable Seasonal Outfits are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley - Seasonal outfits (DSV)[/url]. Additionally, there are bits of dialogue that will be altered depending on which outfit she is wearing!
[*]Included an expanded Bad-End Event Sequence! The consequences of telling Katrielle to not talk to the Pelican Town residents one single time, now fully realized. This was made mostly to have it feel a bit more in-line with the good end and the secret route in terms of content. Like with the secret route, [b]this WILL have permanent consequences for Katrielle[/b] if you choose to follow the ending.
[*]Added a third variation of the 6-Heart Event, in the instance that you are married to Haley at the time of seeing the event.
[*]Added one additional Dating Path Event, to take place after the 6-Heart Dating Event.
[*]Added one additional Secret Route Event, to take place after what was previously the final event.
[*]The mod now handles the Dating Path and the Secret Route Events quite differently now. Previously, all events would take place in an entirely different season from the previous event. This was kinda finicky, and it was brought to my attention that, particularly for the dating events, you would be unable to view events after the first one if you seen the event on the wrong season. [b]The new implementation works such that you would need to wait 14 in-game days for the next event in the lineup (assuming you meet the requirements to see each event).[/b] The exception to this is the final event in the secret route, as that would take 28 in-game days. For more details, please see the event guide listed below.
[*]With the addition of 1.6, there no longer is a need to have a separate music mod to handle the custom tracks that play for Katrielle!
[*]Updated Katrielle's gift preferences to make it more accessible to give her gifts, as well as accommodating existing 1.6 items.
[*]Fixed the bug with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20938]Custom Fixed Dialogue - Continued[/url], where Katrielle's dialogue would overwrite other NPCs in town.
[*]All lines of dialogue have been included under the default i18n file. [b]For Translators, please use this file as the source for ALL dialogue.[/b]
[*]In addition, several lines of dialogue has been added as well, in accordance with the new lines 1.6 offers. There's always room to continue adding lines, but I'm happy with the roughly 2000 lines of dialogue Katrielle and Events contain.
[*]Some of the Katrielle glitch lines were using an incorrect cypher, so each glitch text should be accurate now.
[*]Adjusted the 0-Heart Event, if the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11594]Beach Extension For Crab Pod[/url] is present. Incidentally, thank you to tikamin557 for including compatibility with Katrielle, though that did make the 0-Heart event a little funnier as a result. :]
[*]Fixed the entrance to Isla's house, should the [url=www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6931]Isla - Custom NPC[/url] be installed.
[*]Adjusted the Mod Events with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14158]Sydney - A Custom NPC[/url] to the updated name that Sydney uses internally. In addition, the event has also been adjusted to accommodate for the aforementioned Beach Extension for Crab Pod mod and the Isla mod.
[*]Apparently, the festivals on Year 2 shuffled around some things, so Katrielle will be standing in a different spot during the Feast of the Winter Star, if she actually wants to go.
[*]A lot of the internal NPC manifestation stuff was redone since 1.6 updated how NPCs are created.
[*]There were some slight schedule changes. The big one was to accommodate Jessie from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url], as they would attempt to stand on the same spot on a typical rainy day.
[*]A couple of events were touched up to be a little bit smoother with transitions and movement.
[*]The Traveling Cart Lady has a portrait for sale! If you get married with Katrielle, she will sell a portrait of Katrielle that, personally, I think it'd pop out in any home. :]
[*]The 14-Heart Event formerly broke, intentionally. Unfortunately, 1.6 fixed the breaking the 14-Heart event, so I had to re-break the 14-Heart event. It makes sense in context, I promise.
(For old updates/changes, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1469]here[/url].)[center]-----------------[/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/875EcdD.png[/img][/center][*][b]Standalone Mod![/b] You can run this mod [i]solely[/i] with just [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. However, I would personally recommend having [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] so you can easily switch the config options that Katrielle has. As of 1.3.0, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20938]Custom Fixed Dialogue[/url] integration will also be included to glitch out some extra dialogue. :]
[*][b]Over 15 different portraits and several spritesheets![/b] For one single character, she sure is expressive! Watch as she plays the guitar, types on the keyboard, and make many, many different faces as the farmer wrecks havoc on her life!
[*][b]Over 400 lines of dynamic dialogue![/b] Many lines of dialogue changes depending on what you've done in the Stardew Valley™, whether it's getting married with Katrielle or someone else, or completed the community center versus the capitalist route, or being at the beach at 6AM sharp on the day of the Egg Festival, or even breaking the game by being somewhere when you shouldn't!
[*][b]Twenty-one total events and counting![/b] And like with the dynamic dialogue, many of these events change depending on what the farmer has done or seen. Many of the events contribute to an ongoing story line. Which leads me into...
[*][b]Two routes and four total endings![/b] The story line for Katrielle has four possible endings, two of which are very, very clear to as to how to get them. The third one requires you to be a little more thorough to see it, and the last ending is quite easy to miss, as it requires you to be at the right place, at the right time, with the right prerequisites fulfilled, every time. You can even skip out on the events, if you so please! Katrielle's dialogue will change and reflect which events have or have not been seen, but it can and will drastically change once you reached the ending, whichever one it may be. How to get each event will be described under the events section.
[*][b]A cute little house![/b] Everyone's got to have a place to live, right? It's a little hard on the eyes, but looks are deceiving. There are certain gameplay benefits that her house offers. What those are, I'll leave it to you to figure out on your own.
[*][b]Katrielle is romancable![/b] Because of course she is. But hey, you don't have to romance her. Maybe someone else will do it instead? Then again, I did recommend single player over multiplayer. Eh, it's your call. No judgement.
[*][b]Mod compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url], and more![/b] Some mods have already been integrated with Katrielle, and more will be on the way! Hopefully Katrielle won't crash your game when there's other mods available. [b]Full Mod Compatibility list [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fPCymMXsh0SpXDGmja6FehaNxPncjBmmxowxEjgG6fk/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url].[/b]
[/list][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/wxMyhsz.png[/img][/center]Here are all the vague details about Katrielle.[b]Birthday:[/b] The concept of Katrielle was made on June 9, 2021 (Summer 9).[b]Schedule:[/b] She'll tend to stick around her house for a majority of the time. Finding her won't be a difficult task once you find her home. Oh, but don't talk to her on the 21st of each month. For a more comprehensive list, see below:[spoiler][center][b]You will not be able to see her prior to the 0-Heart cutscene. Look below for how to see the event.[/b]

After the 0-Heart cutscene:[/center][list][*]On most days, she will stay in bed until 2PM. If you try to talk to her before 9 PM, she will say something along the lines of "I was out/up late last night, sucks doesn't it."
[*]After that, she'll hop onto her computer, and use it until around 8PM.
[*]At 8PM, she will abandon her redditor lifestyle to stare out into the ocean, right outside her house, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]On Thursdays, she will leave her house to see the rest of the town instead of sleeping in bed at night. In Spring, Summer, and Fall, she'll go to the Town and the Mountains around 10PM. In Winter, she'll go to the Forest around 7:30PM. And she'll stay out for the rest of the in-game day.
[*]On the 21st of every season, she will stand in place and glitch out, making just about all of her dialogue illegible.
[*]If it is raining, she'll get up out of bed and stand in her house until 10AM. Then she'll stand outside and stare into the ocean until 12AM(not PM), where she will then go to sleep.
[*]For all festivals on the beach (Luau, Dance of the Moonlight Jellies, and the entirety of the Winter Night market), she'll just stay at home the entire day.
[/list]Her schedule will not change until you have completed the Main Path. [b]However, if you get the bad ending, her schedule will only change slightly. She generally will NOT step outside of her house at all for the Bad Ending.[/b][center]After the Good/Best Ending[/center][list][*]If it is raining, she'll get up out of bed and stand in her house until 10AM. Then she'll stand outside and stare into the ocean until 12AM(not PM), where she will then go to sleep.
[*]On the 21st of every season, she will stand in place and glitch out, making just about all of her dialogue illegible.
[*]For all festivals on the beach (Luau, Dance of the Moonlight Jellies, and the entirety of the Winter Night market), she'll just stay at home the entire day.
[*]If you are married to Katrielle, she will go to her house to use the computer until 5PM. After that, she will start walking back to the farm.
[/list][list]
[*]Spring Mondays: She'll leave her house at 11AM to go to Town, then come back to the Beach around 9PM, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Spring Tuesdays: She'll leave her house at 12PM to go to Town, then come back to the Beach around 11PM, before going to bed at 1AM.
[*]Spring Wednesdays: She'll stay in bed until 9AM. She'll walk around her room until 11AM, where she'll use the computer until 6PM. At 6PM, she'll go to the beach to stare out into the ocean, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Spring Thursdays: She'll leave her house at 9AM to go to Town, then go to the Saloon at 2PM, go back outside around 7:30PM, and walk to the Mountains starting at 12AM and stay there for the rest of the night.
[*]Spring Friday: She'll stay in bed until 11AM. She'll use the computer until 6PM. At 6PM, she'll go to the beach to stare out into the ocean, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Spring Saturdays: Same as Spring Wednesdays.
[*]Spring Sundays: She'll head out to the Church in Pierre's shop at starting at 7AM. At 4PM, she'll loiter around Town until 8:30PM, where she'll go to the beach. She stays at the beach until 12AM, where she'll then go to sleep.
[/list][list]
[*]Summer Mondays: She'll stay in bed until 10AM. She'll then use the computer until 5PM. At 5PM, she'll go to the beach to stare out into the ocean, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Summer Tuesdays: She'll leave her house at 10:30AM to go to Town, then come back to the Beach around 5PM, before going to bed at 1AM.
[*]Summer Wednesdays: Same as Summer Mondays.
[*]Summer Thursdays: She'll leave her house at 9AM to go to Town, then go to the Saloon at 2PM, go back outside around 7:30PM, and walk to the Mountains starting at 11PM and stay there for the rest of the night.
[*]Summer Fridays: Same as Summer Mondays.
[*]Summer Saturdays: She'll leave her house at 7:30AM to go to Town, then go to the Forest at 1PM, and start walking back home to sleep at 11:30PM.
[*]Summer Sundays: She'll leave her house at 9AM to go to the Forest, then start walking towards the Railroads north of Robin's house at 2PM, and start walking back home to sleep at 10PM.
[/list][list]
[*]Fall Mondays: She'll stay in bed until 12PM. She'll then start walking to the Museum at 12PM. At 6PM, she'll go to the beach to stare out into the ocean, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Fall Tuesday: She'll stay in bed until 9AM. She'll then use the computer until 2PM. At 2PM, she'll go to the beach for a while, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Fall Wednesday: She'll immediately get up to walk to the Bus Stop. She'll stay there until 1PM, where she'll go to Town. At 4PM, she'll go to the beach, before going to bed at 1AM.
[*]Fall Thursday: She'll leave her house at 9AM to go to Town, then go to the Saloon at 2PM, go back outside around 7:30PM, and walk to the Mountains starting at 11PM and stay there for the rest of the night. She will leave to Town at 7:30AM and to the Saloon around 12PM on Fall 11. She will leave the Saloon at 4PM on Fall 4.
[*]Fall Friday: She'll stay in bed until 3PM. She'll then use the computer until 10PM. At 10PM, she'll go to the beach for a while, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Fall Saturday: She'll stay in bed until 11AM. She'll then go to Pierre's Shop and stay there until 4PM. At 4PM, she'll go to the Saloon. At 12PM, she'll go to bed.
[*]Fall Sunday: Same as Fall Tuesday.
[/list][list]
[*]Winter Mondays: She'll stay in bed until 8AM. She'll go out to the beach until 3PM. She'll then go back inside her house and loiter around until 8PM, where she'll her her computer. She'll go to bed at 12AM.
[*]Winter Tuesday: She'll stay in bed until 9AM. She'll then go to the bathhouse, and stay in the women's locker room. At 4PM, stay outside of the bathhouse, next to the railroads until 7PM. At 7PM, she'll walk back home to use her computer. After that, she'll go outside briefly at 12AM, before going back to bed at 1AM.
[*]Winter Wednesday: She'll stay in bed until 9AM. She'll then loiter around her house until 4PM, then she'll use the computer until 8PM. At 8PM, she'll go to the beach for a while, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Winter Thursday: She'll leave her house at 9AM to go to Town. At 1PM, she will go to the Forest. Then, she'll go to the Saloon at 8PM. At 12AM, she'll walk back to the Forest and stay there for the rest of the day.
[*]Winter Friday: She'll stay in bed until 12PM. She'll then loiter around her house until 4PM, then she'll use the computer until 8PM. At 8PM, she'll go to the beach for a while, before going to bed at 12AM.
[*]Winter Saturday: She'll stay in bed until 1PM. She'll then go to Town and stay there until 7PM. At 7PM, she'll go to the Saloon. At 12PM, she'll go to bed.
[*]Winter Sunday: Same as Winter Wednesday.
[/list][/spoiler][b]Loved Gifts:[/b] Many of her loved gifts are very random, and figuring out which items she would like will be difficult. She can reach into the void and grab anything that she wants, so items that have a higher value to the player won't be appreciated by Katrielle. For a practical list, see below:[spoiler]For loved items, the easiest item to get is Bug Steak, Red Mushroom, and Moss. She also likes Blobfish, Fire Quartz Strange Dolls (both kinds), Jack o' Lanterns, Void Salmon, Ginger Ale, and Ginger Island Warp Totems.For liked items, some of the easier items to get are Broken CDs, Spring Onions, Sweet Peas and Winter Roots. Some later game items she likes are are Coconuts, Cactus Fruit, Strange Buns, Slime Eggs, and the Farm, Mountain, and Beach warp totems.Of note, many universal likes and loves are disliked by Katrielle, including but not limited to, all fruits from trees, Diamonds, and Prismatic Shards.[/spoiler][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/t3LxBXx.png[/img][/center][size=4][b][center]Hints for the Main Path[/center][/b][/size][center]If you only want a vague hint for each of the storyline events, as well as the bad, good, and best endings:[/center][spoiler][list][*]0-Heart Event: A farmer must be able to farm, forage, fish, mine, and fight. From there, it's just a matter of having access to her house, and talking to the first person that sees her. Maybe they'll be looking around after hours. Of note, you will be unable to meet her if you haven't done this event!
[*]2-Heart Event: Only a sociopath would wake up willingly at 6AM. And Shane. That's why nearly everyone is still asleep, and is the perfect time to walk around if you want to avoid everyone else like the plague.
[*]4-Heart Event: Sometimes, watching a potential romance bloom is worthwhile. But I wonder which two people she thinks would make a good couple. They'd probably be around one of their houses, right?
[*]6-Heart Event: Tinkering around with things is not a great idea, made much worse when someone decides to deviate from the script. Oh well, at least it's a bright and sunny day, and the nature of the forest looks beautiful.
[*]8-Heart Event: The big choice is here. If Katrielle is well acquainted with everyone, her introduction will be smooth and easy. If not, well, it's not the end of the world, I hope. But you'll need a big crowd to make the announcement.
[*]10-Heart Event: Whatever happens, you know Katrielle would be content back in her nice and comfortable bubble she calls her home.
[*]14-Heart Event: Go back to where it all started. Same time, too.
[/list][/spoiler][center]-----------------[/center][center]Here is a much more exhaustive list of each event, how to see them, and what actions will affect each event. [b]SPOILERS FOR ALL EVENTS[/b]

[size=4][b]The Main Path[/b][/size][/center]These are the events that serve as the main conflict for Katrielle. There is an ongoing story line that will end differently depending on which cutscenes you have seen.[spoiler][list][*]For ALL events, it CANNOT be the 21st of the season.
[*]0-Heart Event: Go to the beach after 8PM, after repairing the wooden bridge and getting the fishing rod and the sword. It cannot be the same day as a festival. If you have the Crab Pods mod, you do not need to repair the wooden bridge. After this event, you can walk to Katrielle's house by "no-clipping" on the rightmost pier.
[*]2-Heart Event: Go to Pelican Town between 6AM and 9AM, on a sunny day. You can NOT be dating Sam or Katrielle, and you can NOT see the 8-Heart Event before this event.
[*]4-Heart Event: Go to the Mountains between 12PM and 4PM. It can NOT be Friday or Saturday. You can NOT be dating Abigail or Sebastian, and you can NOT see the 8-Heart Event before this event. In the first question prompt, picking the first or third answer will increase your friendship with Katrielle. Picking the second answer will decrease your friendship with Katrielle. The second question prompt will have no effect aside from dialogue. You will get different dialogue if you have met Dwarf, and you will receive a friendship benefit with either Katrielle or Abigail and Sebastian, depending on your answer in the third question prompt.
[*]6-Heart Event: Go to Cindersap Forest between 8AM and 12PM, on a sunny day. It can NOT be winter. You can NOT see the 8-Heart Event before this event. You will get different dialogue if you have at least four hearts with Haley, as well as if your are married to Haley and if another player has seen this event at least one day beforehand. In the question prompt, if you pick the first or second answer, your friendship with Katrielle will decrease. If you pick the third answer, your friendship with Katrielle will remain the same. If you pick the fourth answer, your friendship with Katrielle will increase.
[*]8-Heart Event: Go to Stardrop Saloon between 8PM and 12AM. It can NOT be Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday. The choice to pick out the ending will be decided here. If you pick the first answer option, you will get the bad ending and your friendship with Katrielle will drastically decrease and you will be on the route to the Bad End.. If you pick the second option, but you have NOT seen every previous heart event, you will get the good ending. If you pick the second option, and you have seen every previous Heart Event, you will get the best ending. This event will play out differently depending on if you have seen the 2-Heart Event, the 4-Heart Event or its deviation, the 6-Heart Event or its deviation, and if you seen Elliott's 8-Heart Event (him reading his book in the Museum). If one player has received the bad ending, but another player gets the good or best ending, ALL players will get the good or best ending.
[*]Second 8-Heart Event: Go to Town between 9AM to 5PM, on a sunny day. It cannot be the same day as a festival. You MUST be on the path for the good or best ending. This event will play out differently depending on if you have seen the 2-Heart Event, the 4-Heart Event, the 6-Heart Event, or any combination of the three. If you have seen all three events, it will also include Kent and Leo, should they have moved into Pelican Town. At this point, you can consider the main story line concluded. After seeing this event, Katrielle's House will play a different song.
[*]9-Heart Event: Go outside on your farm. You must have gotten the good or best ending, and you must be dating Katrielle (specifically dating, NOT married or engaged). The options provided will allow you to lower your relationship with her. After this event, you are able to see the Dating Path events.
[*]10-Heart Event: Go to Katrielle's House. You cannot see any of these events if you are on the Secret Route. This event will play out differently depending if you have not seen the 8-Heart Event, if you ONLY have seen the first 8-Heart event, if you have gotten the bad ending, if you have gotten the good ending, or if you have gotten the best ending.
[*]14-Heart Event: Go to the Beach after 8PM.
[/list][/spoiler][center]-----------------[/center][center][size=4][b]The Dating Path and other Miscellaneous Events[/b][/size][/center]The Dating Path include all events that are meant to be seen before marriage with Katrielle. Unlike the Main Path, these events serve more as one-off events.[spoiler][list][*]For ALL events, you can NO LONGER see any of these events after getting engaged or married to Katrielle, unless you go through the process of divorcing her, wiping her memories, and dating her again.
[*]To see each event, you must see each event in chronological order (eg. If you see the 2-Heart Dating Event, you must see the 4-Heart Dating Event before seeing the 6-Heart Dating Event.
[*]To begin, you must see the 9-Heart Event.
[*]9-Heart Event: Go outside on your farm. You must have gotten the good or best ending, and you must be dating Katrielle (specifically dating, NOT married or engaged). The options provided will allow you to lower your relationship with her. After this event, you are able to see the rest of the Dating Path events.
[*]2-Heart Dating Event: Go to the Blacksmith. If you pick the first or third answer, your friendship with Clint will remain the same. If you pick the second answer, your friendship with Clint will decrease.
[*]4-Heart Dating Event: Go to Pelican Town between 9AM and 6PM, on a sunny day. You must have 2 Hearts with Abigail and Sebastian. If you pick the first, third, or fourth answer, your friendship with Katrielle will remain the same. If you pick the second answer, your friendship with Katrielle will decrease.
[*]6-Heart Dating Event: Go to Cindersap Forest between 11AM and 4PM. You must have 6 Hearts with Leah and have seen her 4-Heart Event (Leah calling on the phone). If you pick the first answer, your relationship with Leah will decrease. If you pick the second answer, your friendship with Leah will remain the same.
[*]8-Heart Dating Event: Go to Robin's house. The only requirement is to have Katrielle at 8 Hearts. If you select the second answer, the event will play out a little bit differently. After this event, you should receive a letter in the mail indicating that this is the final dating event.
[*]Bad-End Events: Go to Katrielle's House. You can NOT be married to Katrielle. You will get a short cutscene the next seven times you show up at Katrielle's house. However, if you see the latter half of the cutscenes on a day should be glitching out, the following visit WILL be the final event. After seeing this event, you will no longer be able to date Katrielle, and if you are dating Katrielle, she will promptly break up with you.
[*]Divorce Event: After divorcing Katrielle, go to the farm.
[*]Modding Event: If you have any compatible NPC mods (which, as of 1.3.0, is just [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14158]Sydney[/url]), this event will occur as soon as you have achieved the good/best ending. This event will also occur semi-randomly, determined if the total number of days played divided by 20 is less than 10. Go outside onto your farm.
[*]Sydney Event: Go to the beach between 10AM and 5PM. You must have at least 4 hearts with Katrielle and 6 hearts with Sydney, and you must have seen Sydney's 6-Heart event. The event will play out differently if you have seen Sydney's 8-Heart event. If you have NOT seen Sydney's 8-Heart event and you pick the second answer in the second question prompt, your friendship with Sydney will decrease. If you have seen Sydney's 8-Heart event and you pick the first answer, your friendship with Sydney will decrease. All other answer choices will not have an impact on friendship.
[/list][/spoiler][center]-----------------[/center][center][size=4][b]The Secret Route[/b][/size][/center]These are the events for the secret route. Of note, this route will have the largest effect on the game, and the effects on your save file will be PERMANENT, so proceed with caution.[spoiler][list][*]Firstly, by pursuing this route, you will render not only Katrielle, but also Sam as no longer romanceable.
[*]The first half of this route REQUIRES you to have the prerequisites ON THE SAME DAY as you see the Heart Events on the Main Path. If you miss a single event in this first half, or if another player has picked the good/best ending for the first 8-Heart Cutscene on the Main Path, you will NOT be able to see the rest of the events, and you are back onto the Main Path. THIS IS PERMANENT, AND YOU WILL NEED TO START A NEW FILE TO SEE THIS ROUTE.
[*]For all events, you must NOT be dating Katrielle or Sam.
[*]2-Heart Secret Event: Go to Sam's house on the same day as seeing the 2-Heart Event. You must have 2 Hearts with Sam, and you must have seen Sam's 2-Heart Event (Sam and Sebastian practicing in his room). If you skip the cutscene, or if you pick the first, third, or fourth answer, you will lock yourself out of the route. If you pick the second answer, you will be able to continue the route.
